concerns.text: T023 (Orchestration) depends on T021a (Baseline Runner) completion, but T021a is marked [P] (parallel-safe) alongside T019 (Lite Engine). T023 cannot run until BOTH T019 and T021a are complete. Marking T021a as [P] implies it has no dependencies, yet T023 explicitly requires it. This creates a semantic ordering violation where the 'Producer' (T021a) is flagged as parallel-safe while the 'Consumer' (T023) waits for it, potentially misleading the execution engine into running T023 before T021a finishes if the [P] tag is interpreted as 'no upstream blockers'.

T028b (Regression Analysis) depends on T023 (Orchestration) which generates the metric logs. However, T028b is listed in Phase 5 (US3) while T023 is in Phase 4 (US2). The dependency is correctly noted ('Requires T023 completion'), but T028b is grouped with T027 (T-test) which also requires T023. The ordering is semantically correct (Producer T023 -> Consumer T028b), but the [P] tag on T027 (if implied by grouping) would be incorrect as it shares the same dependency. Ensure T027 and T028b are not marked [P] if they depend on T023.

T007b (Annotation Extractor) produces `data/raw/ground_truth_annotations.csv`. T011 (Static Analysis) and T019 (FastContext-Lite) implicitly require ground-truth data for validation/precision calculation (per FR-001 and US2). T007b is placed in Phase 2 (Foundational) but is NOT marked as a dependency for T011 or T019. If T011/T019 attempt to run before T007b completes, they will fail or produce invalid results. T007b must be explicitly listed as a prerequisite for T011 and T019, or moved to a strict 'Pre-US' block with hard dependencies.

T001 is marked [X] (completed) but the description says 'FAILED: unspecified'. This is a state inconsistency. If the task is truly failed, it cannot be a prerequisite for T001b or T002. If it is a placeholder, the status should be [ ] or [P] (if parallel). The current state blocks the logical flow of the 'Setup' phase.
